entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jameh Mosque of Namin is a Shia Friday mosque, located in Namin, in the province of Ardabil, Iran. The mosque was built during the Qajar era, by the order of Farkhondeh Khanoom, a benevolent lady. It is situated on Imam Khomeini Street, near the bazaar. The mosque facilities include a hammam.
